notes: Rig bodies: Core, 2 Legs, 2 Arms; the head and both ear triggers are extra colliders on the Core body, soles on the legs, hands on the arms.
BunnyRig spawns a BunnyTurn component; with no turn input it stays inert.
Tuning comes from ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<BunnyTuning>() (C# defaults); the project asset was verified identical to the defaults.
World settings are applied by the BunnyRig constructor via tuning.ApplyWorldSettings().
grabBreakForce is float(Infinity); JSON shows the float max. The JS port uses Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY.
